numerical_approach: Exact symbolic arbitrary-degree proof, no interval computation or external numeric oracle.
mathematical_route: Odd part does not increase error or degree; even square contracts to actual polynomial in x² with degree≤D. Reverse affine substitution maps [-1,1] onto [δ²,1]. Genuine pointwise estimates and Mathlib exterior Chebyshev extremality give (1+ε²)/(2ε)≤(r^D+r^(-D))/2. Actual Chebyshev evaluation follows cosh/log APIs. Strict positive slack between error and r^D avoids a separate zero-error argument; contradiction is exact real algebra.
source_credit: George Stepaniants, MF-02 solution Section 2; pinned Mathlib polynomial/Chebyshev/real analysis APIs.
scope: All real 0<δ<1, all natural D≥1, every real polynomial of natDegree≤D, actual uniformError on both intervals. No extra premise, no sorry, no native_decide.
unchanged_files: Frozen boundary and other authors modules untouched.
